settings.heading: Built for the way you actually live
settings.content: We started Pulse because every health wearable we tried felt like a compromise. Too bulky. Too techy. Too distracting. So we built something different — premium wearables that disappear on your wrist or finger and deliver insights that actually change behavior.

settings.heading: Better data. Better days.
settings.body: Continuous biometric tracking shouldn't require a clinic. We pack medical-grade sensors and the AI to make sense of them into wearables you'll forget you're wearing.

settings.heading: Engineers, athletes, and sleep scientists
settings.body: Our team includes ex-Apple Watch engineers, Olympic coaches, and PhDs in chronobiology. We obsess over the details so you don't have to.

settings.heading: Your data belongs to you
settings.body: Privacy isn't a feature. It's the foundation. End-to-end encrypted. Never sold. Always deletable.
